brief:
Middle East Eye reported that Israel has begun dropping explosive-laden boxes from aircraft over Gaza. The new weapons were encountered by residents including Jaber Yaseen's family, who heard a loud engine approaching their home as they prepared a traditional Friday meal of maftoul.

Details about the specific design, intended targets, or scale of deployment of the dropped explosives remain unclear from available reports.
dek: Explosive-laden boxes dropped from the sky: Israel’s latest weapon in Gaza Jaber Yaseen's family was preparing the traditional maftoul dish for their Friday family lunch when they heard a loud engine approaching.
title: Israel deploys explosive-laden boxes dropped from aircraft in Gaza
